verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that BigQuery notebooks (Colab Enterprise) combine SQL queries with Python code, rich text and visualizations in a single integrated interface, which covers the core of mixing SQL and Python with charts. Related docs on end-to-end ML workflows in one notebook and on Data Canvas query-and-visualize support this. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline result rendering/output behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the notebook experience.
